dialogues.speaker: Lohen
dialogues.text: I manage my time carefully to save as much energy as possible for the battlefield. With so much fighting to do, I rest only when needed...

dialogues.speaker: Lohen
dialogues.text: When allocating a resource like time, it's important not to let emotions cloud your judgment — or to overcomplicate things by trying to be too smart.

dialogues.speaker: Lohen
dialogues.text: For now, I have orders to make camp and rest. Remember to call me before we move out.

dialogues.speaker: Lohen
dialogues.text: Time to set off? Sure, but... mind if I take the lead? Kinda curious what strange new enemies we might run into...

dialogues.speaker: Lohen
dialogues.text: That said, you're the captain of this adventure — my role is yours to assign.

dialogues.speaker: Lohen
dialogues.text: Just... don't stick me in the center, alright? That's always the last place to see any action.

dialogues.speaker: Lohen
dialogues.text: Fairy tales... Fairy tales... Nothing but fairy tales...

dialogues.speaker: Lohen
dialogues.text: Too thin... Too thick... This cover's too hard... This one doesn't even have a cover...

dialogues.speaker: Lohen
dialogues.text: *sigh* So many books full of fairy tales, yet not a single one that would make a half-decent pillow. If only those authors had knuckled down a bit harder, I might have some better options here.
